profile.capacity_note: Corrected, this row is at the Texas Research Park campus in Bexar County, not the Frontier mega-campus in Shackelford County. 32 MW and 242,665 sq ft filed per trade press but not confirmed operational, recorded in planned_capacity not critical_it_mw.
profile.research_note:
Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 31 (Vantage missing-address campaign): corrected an erroneous Frontier association, added an aggregator-corroborated address and trade-press-sourced planned capacity, flagged an address discrepancy in the DCD article text. research_status remains complete.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This Vantage Data Centers facility, TX11, is at Vantages Texas Research Park campus in Bexar County, Texas, near the crossing of Omicron Drive and Theta Drive. Two independent data center directories, datacenterHawk and DataCenterMap, both give this buildings address as 14720 Omicron Drive, San Antonio, TX, these are leads-only aggregator sources per this projects source hierarchy, not confirmed directly by the operator. Trade press (DataCenterDynamics, tier-4 source, https://www.datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/vantage-files-plans-for-san-antonio-data-center/) reported Vantage filed plans for this facility in December 2023, describing 32 MW of critical IT load and 242,665 square feet, targeting an early 2026 completion. As of this research pass in September 2026 that target date has passed but no source found this session explicitly confirms the facility is now operational, so the 32 MW figure is recorded as planned rather than asserted into critical_it_mw. The same DataCenterDynamics article also described this filing using a street number matching the registrys neighboring TX12 row, conflicting with the two aggregators independent agreement on 14720 for this row, this discrepancy is noted rather than silently resolved. A prior note on this row associated it with Frontier, a Vantage mega-campus announced August 2025. This is corrected here, Vantages own August 2025 press release (tier-1 operator source, https://vantage-dc.com/news/vantage-data-centers-unveils-plans-for-frontier-a-25b-mega-campus-in-texas-to-meet-unprecedented-ai-demand/) states Frontier is a 1,200 acre, 1.4 GW, 25 billion dollar, ten building campus in Shackelford County, Texas, near Albany, roughly 300 miles from San Antonio and Bexar County. Frontier is not the San Antonio area campus this row belongs to, it is a separate, later, and much larger project elsewhere in Texas.
